claims.claim: The sewing machine is in very good condition.
claims.evidence: The report describes appearance only; whether it powers on, runs, or sews is not shown.

claims.claim: It is ready to buy and use.
claims.evidence: No video or demonstration of the machine operating is included in the report.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or sew correctly.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine switched on and stitching fabric.

risks.risk: The age or year of manufacture is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the model and serial number plate, or the original purchase receipt.

risks.risk: Accessories such as bobbins, needles, or manuals may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories together with the machine.

risks.risk: Service history or previous repairs are unknown.
risks.proof: Service records or close-up photos of any repaired or replaced parts.

risks.risk: Warranty status is unknown and likely expired.
risks.proof: A warranty card or original receipt showing warranty coverage.

risks.risk: The photo may be scraped from Jumia (SHARON TAYLOR / POSTED ON JUMIA watermarks) and not show the seller's actual machine.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine with a handwritten note naming the buyer and dated today.
risks.if_unproven: as possibly not in the seller's possession

proof_requests: Video of the sewing machine powered on and stitching
Photo of the model and serial number plate
Original receipt or warranty card if available
Photo of the machine with a handwritten note naming the buyer and dated today
response.reason: The witness identified a Janome sewing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case as non-working with no accessories; proof of function, model, and possession would raise the value.
